doc: Ambient walkers of the night quay (round 9, feel pass 2): scripts/actors/ambient_walker.gd, instanced by the scene.json actor res://scenes/actors/AmbientWalkers.tscn. Own rig sheets in walkers/ from tools/pixelgen/walkers_r8.py (colour variants of worker_b, worker_a, clerk, babushka and the conductor -- none of them stands or speaks on the quay; side, front and back walk rows). Side level: every lane is y 295, between the props (base_y <= 294) and the walk band (296-306), so the player and every NPC pass in front. Lanes keep clear of the fire engine (x 258-432), the bench with the file (733-788) and Konrad (800-818), the trestle (1060-1104) and the cars (1106-1422); nobody pauses on a story spot. Two walkers share each of the west promenade and the bridge approach: head-on, the lower rank steps half a pixel back (they pass one behind the other), followers keep their distance.

walkers.note: a fireman of the Veltrava brigade walks the hose line from the engine toward the lanterns and back
a man from the old town in his coat over pyjama trousers, woken by the fire; stops and points at it
a commission clerk carrying an armful of rescued folders toward the cars and back for the next
an old woman in her headscarf on the bridge approach; stops to look back at the fire
a city policeman (green-grey, not the commission's blue) paces the bridge approach
